subject: Bertucci's Underage Alcohol Sale Hearing
overview: The Medford Liquor License Commission approved two one-day license requests and accepted its annual report. The commission also held a disciplinary hearing regarding an underage alcohol sale compliance violation at Bertucci's and took the matter under advisement.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from November 19, 2025, and December 17, 2025.

items.title: One-Day License Application: Medford Public Library
items.summary: Approved a one-day liquor license for a retirement event at the Medford Public Library on April 12, 2026.

items.title: One-Day License Application: Mary Queen of Peace Parish
items.summary: Conditionally approved a one-day license for a January 31, 2026, speed dating event, subject to receipt of liability insurance.

items.title: Disciplinary Hearing: Bertucci's Underage Alcohol Sale
items.summary: Held a hearing regarding a December 11, 2025, police compliance check where two underage operatives were served alcohol at Bertucci's. Legal counsel for the restaurant detailed corrective measures taken, including employee termination and staff retraining, and the commission took the matter under advisement.

items.title: Review of Annual Report
items.summary: Accepted the commission's annual report detailing license availability, compliance checks, and violation findings from the past year.
